hazards.reason: Product.items changes from a list of TEXT to a list of INTEGER: SQLite converts each element with a cast that never fails, so the conversion does not keep every element: text that is not a number becomes 0 and a fraction is cut toward zero.

hazards.reason: SQLite's ALTER TABLE cannot drop NOT NULL from price and convert the elements of items, so the step rebuilds product: it copies the rows into a new table, drops the old one and renames the new one.
hazards.subject: table/product

statements:
CREATE TABLE "_new_product" (
  "id" TEXT DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || substr('89ab', 1 + (random() & 3), 1) || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6)))) NOT NULL,
  "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "items" TEXT,
  "price" INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

INSERT INTO "_new_product" ("id", "title", "items", "price")
SELECT "id", "title", CASE WHEN "product"."items" IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT json_group_array(CAST("_element"."value" AS INTEGER) ORDER BY "_element"."key") FROM json_each("product"."items") AS "_element") END, "price"
FROM "product"
